subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Instead, they are asked to learn.”?
options: It is giving useful information before the person feels embarrassed to ask.
It is giving in a way that protects the person receiving it.
It is to fix the habit of giving up too soon.
People should know what they are giving when they choose it.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It is giving useful information before the person feels embarrassed to ask.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It is giving in a way that protects the person receiving it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Instead, they are asked to learn. It is to fix the habit of giving up too soon.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「People should know what they are giving when they choose it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Instead, they are asked to learn. It is to fix the habit of giving up too soon.」，答案為「It is to fix the habit of giving up too soon.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It is to fix the habit of giving up too soon.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
